question: What are thunderstorms in Assam during the month of ‘Baisakhi’ called?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bardoisila__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Norwesters:

 
 
• It is also known as **Kalbaishakhi in West Bengal **or **Bardoisila in Assam**.
 
• It is an isolated rainfall and thunderstorm that occurs in India and Bangladesh, associated with violent hurricane-speed winds.
 
• It occurs with increasing frequency, from March till monsoon establishes over the region of North-East India.
